description: Check proxy health: bound host/port, the (credential-redacted) upstream engine URL, which authentication admits worker and telemetry connections (auth function, loopback grant, or none; channel sockets are checked by the engine), which endpoints are exposed, and the live downstream connection count.

AuthMode.description: Which authentication admits new connections to the worker endpoint `/` and telemetry `/otel`. `/ws/channels/*` sockets are not authenticated by the proxy in any mode: the engine checks their channel access keys.

oneOf.description: `rbac.auth_function_id` authenticates every worker and telemetry connection.
No auth function; `rbac.loopback_auth` admits loopback peers only to `/` and `/otel`.
Neither: every worker and telemetry connection is refused; channel sockets (`/ws/channels/*`) are not, the engine checks their keys.

auth.description: The authentication in force for new worker (`/`) and telemetry (`/otel`) connections: `function` (the `auth_function_id`), `loopback` (no auth function; `loopback_auth` admits loopback peers) or `none` (every worker and telemetry connection is refused). `/ws/channels/*` sockets are not authenticated by the proxy in any mode: the engine checks their channel access keys.

engine_url.description: Upstream engine URL, with any `user:pass@` credentials redacted.

expose_endpoints.description: The `rbac.expose_endpoints` patterns: the paths the proxy serves. Empty: every connection is refused.
